authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibility: Micro, small and medium enterprises based on investment and turnover
benefit: Online MSME registration and access to MSME support measures

scheme: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
eligibility: Eligible micro and small enterprises and eligible lending institutions
benefit: Credit guarantee cover for eligible collateral-free lending

eligibility: Individuals aged 18 years or above setting up a new manufacturing or service enterprise
benefit: Bank-financed margin money subsidy for new eligible projects
max_amount: Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for services

eligibility: Micro and small enterprises seeking resolution of delayed buyer payments
benefit: Online filing and monitoring of delayed-payment complaints

eligibility: Supplier registered as a micro or small enterprise
benefit: Interest on delayed payments where no written agreement exists or the agreed period is longer than statutory limits
max_amount: Three times the RBI bank rate

scheme: Micro and Small Enterprises Cluster Development Programme
eligibility: Eligible MSME clusters, associations and implementing agencies
benefit: Support for infrastructure, capability building and common facilities

eligibility: MSMEs seeking zero-defect and zero-effect manufacturing assessment
benefit: Certification, handholding and financial support for ZED assessment

eligibility: MSME clusters and enterprises adopting lean practices
benefit: Support for lean implementation and productivity improvement

eligibility: Aspiring entrepreneurs, existing MSME owners and job seekers
benefit: Training in entrepreneurship, management and industrial skills

eligibility: MSMEs participating in ZED assessment and certification
benefit: Guidance and subsidy support for quality, environmental and energy measures

scheme: Micro and Small Enterprises-Development Institute services
eligibility: Existing and prospective MSME owners
benefit: Technical consultancy, training and project support

scheme: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy for Technology Upgradation
eligibility: Eligible MSMEs upgrading specified plant and machinery
benefit: Capital subsidy linked to approved technology upgradation loans
max_amount: As prescribed by the applicable scheme guidelines

eligibility: Entities establishing institutions or facilities for agro-industry entrepreneurship
benefit: Support for technology centres and incubation of rural enterprises

eligibility: MSMEs seeking scheme information, grievance support or assistance
benefit: Digital access to grievance resolution and MSME support services

authority: Government of India through Scheduled Commercial Banks
eligibility: Women and SC or ST entrepreneurs aged 18 years or above establishing a greenfield enterprise
benefit: Composite bank loans covering up to 85 percent of project cost

eligibility: Eligible MSMEs and other borrowers meeting scheme criteria
benefit: Additional credit with government-backed guarantee support
max_amount: Scheme-period limits; based on eligible outstanding credit

authority: Reserve Bank of India regulated TReDS platforms
eligibility: MSME suppliers using approved platforms and eligible buyers
benefit: Electronic discounting of trade receivables against invoices
max_amount: Based on approved credit and invoice value

eligibility: Registered MSMEs selling to eligible government buyers
benefit: Online access to government procurement opportunities

eligibility: MSMEs participating in approved skilling and capacity-building programmes
benefit: Enterprise-focused training and improved access to skills

scheme: Revised MSME investment and turnover classification
eligibility: Enterprises using Udyam investment and turnover criteria
benefit: Classification as micro, small or medium enterprise
max_amount: Medium: investment up to Rs 125 crore and turnover up to Rs 500 crore
